name: Action
descr: Fast-paced games emphasizing reflexes, coordination, and combat.

name: Adventure
descr: Story-driven games focused on exploration, puzzles, and narrative.

name: Role-Playing
descr: Games where you develop a character through quests, stats, and choices.

name: Strategy
descr: Games that reward planning, resource management, and tactical decisions.

name: Simulation
descr: Games that recreate real-world activities or systems, from farming to flying.

name: Sports
descr: Games based on real or fictional athletic competitions.

name: Racing
descr: Competitive driving or racing games, from arcade to realistic simulation.

name: Puzzle
descr: Games centered on logic, pattern recognition, and problem solving.

name: First-Person Shooter
descr: Shooters played from the character's point of view, focused on gunplay.

name: Horror
descr: Games designed to scare, using tension, atmosphere, and survival mechanics.

name: Platformer
descr: Games about running, jumping, and navigating obstacle-filled levels.

name: Fighting
descr: One-on-one or small-group combat games built around combos and timing.

name: Massively Multiplayer
descr: Online games with large persistent worlds shared by many players.

name: Indie
descr: Smaller-scale, creator-driven games, often experimental in style or design.

name: Casual
descr: Easy-to-learn games for short sessions and a wide audience.
